cues.en: Hi, and welcome to another AI and C-Sharp video on the Microsoft 18 Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎收看另一支介紹 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 C# AI 影片。

cues.en: In today's video, we're going to look at Google Gemini and how we can use Google Search inside Gemini.
cues.zh: 今天要介紹 Google Gemini，以及如何在 Gemini 裡使用 Google 搜尋。

cues.en: So, here we are in a sample called Google Gemini Web Search,
cues.zh: 這裡是 Google Gemini Web Search 範例，

cues.en: and if we bring up to the console here, we can see that if we make a normal client for Google Gemini,
cues.zh: 打開主控台，可以看到如果只建立一般 Google Gemini 用戶端，

cues.en: and we just use it as is, it is just like any other model, that it can't really tell anything about,
cues.zh: 不加任何功能，就和其他模型一樣，無法知道，

cues.en: for example, in this case, today's Space News.
cues.zh: 例如今天的太空新聞。

cues.en: So, I'm asking for Space News, just as it shows the date, and max 20 words, so it's not too long.
cues.zh: 我要求提供今天的太空新聞，附上日期，最多二十個詞，避免太長。

cues.en: And if we do that via a normal agent, we get the usual way of responding,
cues.zh: 透過一般代理程式詢問，就會得到常見的回覆，

cues.en: in that it will be some news at its cutoff date.
cues.zh: 也就是模型知識截止日期以前的新聞。

cues.en: And in terms of this Gemini tree flash, that was May 21st, 2024,
cues.zh: 這個 Gemini 3 Flash 的回覆提到 2024 年 5 月 21 日，

cues.en: and they show some news, that news not being from today.
cues.zh: 並列出一些新聞，但不是今天的。

cues.en: So, of course, if we don't give a model anything, it can only know up to its cutoff date.
cues.zh: 如果不提供新資訊，模型當然只能知道知識截止日期以前的事。

cues.en: So, we of course need to give it Web Search, and luckily that's very, very easy for us in Agent Framework,
cues.zh: 因此要加入網頁搜尋，幸好 Agent Framework 很容易做到。

cues.en: in that in the OpenAI versions we have seen of this, we just give something called Hosted Web Search Tool.
cues.zh: 先前 OpenAI 的範例，是提供 HostedWebSearchTool。

cues.en: And that actually works as well for Gemini.
cues.zh: 這個工具在 Gemini 也能使用。

cues.en: So, we just give that tool, and then we ask exactly the same question, what is today's Space News?
cues.zh: 只要加入工具，再問完全相同的問題：「今天有哪些太空新聞？」

cues.en: Now it takes a little longer because it goes out and actually do a search, and we get back with, in my case, the 24th of March,
cues.zh: 現在需要稍久，因為實際會上網搜尋；回覆中顯示 3 月 24 日，

cues.en: which is the day of this recording, where it gives back the real news from today.
cues.zh: 也就是錄影當天，並提供當天的真實新聞。

cues.en: So, that's great.
cues.zh: 這很好。

cues.en: We see that input and output tool looks very, very low.
cues.zh: 可以看到輸入與輸出 Token 都很少。

cues.en: We'll talk a little about cost at the end.
cues.zh: 最後會稍微說明費用。

cues.en: This, however, is behind the scenes something more advanced, and we can go the advanced route, not really that it gives us anything further,
cues.zh: 不過背後其實有更進階的設定，也能直接用原生方式；雖然目前沒有額外好處，

cues.en: but you can see we can go in and make the ChatClientAgentOptions and the normal breaking glass with RawRepresentationFactory.
cues.zh: 可以建立 ChatClientAgentOptions，再透過 RawRepresentationFactory 設定。

cues.en: And inside that, we have the Google way of defining tools, which is a tool instead of an AI tool, and we get a Google search with a search type,
cues.zh: 裡面使用 Google 原生的 Tool，而不是 AITool，並加入指定 SearchType 的 GoogleSearch，

cues.en: and then we can set the web search.
cues.zh: 再設定網頁搜尋。

cues.en: This object have a lot of extra features, but unfortunately they don't work in Gemini, so we can't exclude domains.
cues.zh: 這個物件還有很多選項，但可惜 Gemini 不支援，例如無法排除特定網域。

cues.en: We can't do something called blogging confidence.
cues.zh: 也無法使用 BlockingConfidence 之類的設定。

cues.en: Search type we have, the time range feature won't work either.
cues.zh: SearchType 可以設定，但時間範圍功能也不支援。

cues.en: So, it seems like Google have these things that they can use other places, but not in AI.
cues.zh: 看起來 Google 在其他地方使用這些選項，但 Gemini 並未支援。

cues.en: In the same manner, the search type, there is an image search here, but we can't use it here.
cues.zh: 同樣地，SearchType 雖有圖片搜尋，這裡卻不能使用。

cues.en: If we set these, it will simply just say, Google, Gemini doesn't support these settings.
cues.zh: 設定後，只會回報 Gemini 不支援這些選項。

cues.en: So, in reality, you don't really need to do this, unless at some point we get further things.
cues.zh: 因此除非未來加入其他功能，否則其實不必採取這麼複雜的寫法。

cues.en: But we just use the hosted web tool, but in the end, this can do exactly the same, and will give more or less the same result being AI, of course.
cues.zh: 直接使用 HostedWebSearchTool 即可；原生寫法能做的相同，因為是 AI，結果可能略有差異。

cues.en: So, we get our third response, and it's a different news, because there's multiple news today.
cues.zh: 這是第三次回覆，新聞不一樣，因為今天本來就有很多則新聞。

cues.en: What we can see is a little about the cost.
cues.zh: 接著看一下成本。

cues.en: Web search tools are fairly generous, being Google.
cues.zh: Google 的網頁搜尋額度相當大方。

cues.en: If you go to their pricing page, they mention that you can get 5,000 prompts per month for free, and then after that it's $14 per 1,000 search queries.
cues.zh: 價格頁面提到，每月前五千個提示詞免費，之後每一千個搜尋查詢十四美元。

cues.en: It doesn't work with their free models, but only with their paid models.
cues.zh: 不適用免費模型，只適用付費模型。

cues.en: But fairly generous compared to what you pay for OpenAI.
cues.zh: 不過比 OpenAI 的搜尋費用還是大方不少。

cues.en: So, Google being Google, of course it makes sense that they are good at web search, and luckily for us, we have it very simple to work with those search tools.
cues.zh: Google 本來就擅長搜尋，而我們也很容易在程式中使用這些工具。

cues.en: So, that was it, short one today.
cues.zh: 今天是比較短的一支，就到這裡。

cues.en: See you on the next one.
cues.zh: 我們下支影片見。
